changes.before: At most it shows which avowed contents actually organized the order in that one action. It cannot prove those avowals were not colonized, and it cannot say which of them is more truly his own. That layer was sealed when self-colonization was raised: audit reads only whether the places are open or shut and does not judge what the bearer really avows; an audit that reaches past those three generates, structurally, exactly the relation introjection requires. And what is missing there was never permission at the level of type — it is discovery. Nor can that judgment be contemporaneous: taken as contains within it that one has not, at this moment, seen it to be external, and a man who sees in the moment that this is not from under his own sources dissolves the taking-as on the spot.
